mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are at 51 degrees under clear skies by Reddan Soccer Park, with a Waxing Gibbous moon visible tonight. The overnight low will be 49 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The city has announced that crack filling maintenance begins on September 28, which may cause lane closures in various areas including South Nine Mound Road and North Jefferson Street. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to discuss various development projects, including new site plans at Sub-Zero in Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty happening in town, starting with yoga sessions today at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters at Lake Lou-ee, or Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's. Looking further ahead, don't miss the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday and the popular Verona Fall Fest this Thursday, September 25.

In a weekly update, officers responded to a serious incident on September 10 where a 19-year-old was arrested for burglary and recklessly endangering safety after a shot was fired during a break-in at Hunters Cove Way.

Today's delicious flavor was Caramel Chocolate Pecan. The restaurant is currently closed for the night, so please stop by tomorrow morning at 10:00 AM to enjoy tomorrow's flavor of the day, which is Georgia Peach.
